criteria.scope: Native wgpu-py versus Chromium portable WGSL; identical cropped archived tensile pixels, options and chronological sequence
criteria.preferred: bit equality of every parameter, status and iteration
criteria.basis: Parameter bounds reuse the existing native specialized/portable qualification. Iteration and status disagreements are individually counted and reported; differences are not hidden by a global RMSE.
required: same dense shapes and parameter order
same ROI selection and seed permissions
all 60 frame rows retained including black, reset and expiry
criteria.performance: No universal mobile FPS claim. Record >=60 seconds with worker-frame-available to GPU-field boundary separately from export readback. Hardware and browser version required.
